info.name: NVS Backend API
info.description:
Import this collection into Postman. Run Auth > Login first; it saves access_token and refresh_token for the protected endpoints. All endpoint paths and methods mirror the current NestJS controllers.
UUID POST APIs and UUID GET APIs contain resource UUID routes; original numeric requests remain available. Create examples use related UUID fields where supported, while the backend remains compatible with the corresponding numeric ID fields. Environment variables override collection variables: remove stale UUID environment values if automatic capture appears ineffective. UUID Verification is read-only; the UUID POST APIs folder includes real mutations. Password requests require RSA-OAEP/SHA-256 ciphertext encoded as Base64; set encryptedPassword to a fresh ciphertext for each request.
